notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Efficient Construction triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
The Thopter enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.
